continuation_cursor.last_completed_action: Completed V2-M3 including M3E fixed protection-mode configuration at substantive commit 95be28659a7b3b5fc1723524d10edfd209cae3b5. M3A-D remain byte-for-byte unchanged; M3E is an additive extension in internal/control/config.go plus config_test.go and a separate wbd-config-probe. CONFIG/CONFIG_OK use existing WBDC framing types 9/10 with exactly one mode byte. Only constitution-defined normal, weak-1.5x and weak-2x are admitted; zero, unknown and reserved Auto are rejected, and the CLI rejects Auto before opening a UDP socket. ConfigServerSession wraps the already-qualified M3A-D ServerSession, accepts CONFIG once only after Established/authentication, records Configured and ProtectionMode plus encoded-wire counters, and does not modify UDPspeeder/FEC/carrier behavior. Local authority ran Go tests and direct DTLS using the qualified quiet shim SHA-256 63329b8528196159f430bb89bf40b98e52ed74073f57ed81d068cddb55e50d7a; after both peers reported DTLSv1.3 / TLS_AES_256_GCM_SHA384 READY, HELLO/ACCEPT -> AUTH/AUTH_OK -> CONFIG weak-1.5x/CONFIG_OK passed and server stats recorded configured=true protection_mode=weak-1.5x. docs/protocol/v2-m3e-receipt.json records result=pass. GitHub go test ./... on CI run 32769686064 passed every Go package including internal/control and cmd/wbd-config-probe; build-quic-oracle run 32769686070 passed. The only CI/handoff failure on 95be2865 was the sequence-22 handoff having 13 resume paths while the repository contract allows 3..12; sequence 23 corrects that handoff-only defect. The ROADMAP V2-M3 exit gate is therefore satisfied: version/config framing, optional post-Finished token authorization, keepalive/liveness, session stats, deterministic close/reconnect policy, malformed/auth tests and no custom crypto are all locally qualified.
continuation_cursor.current_task: V2-M4A: qualify the kernel-anchor hypothesis as an isolated Linux packet-capture experiment before any product integration. Establish one real kernel TCP connection/anchor on a 4-tuple, write no application payload to that socket, then independently inject/capture TCP-shaped raw payload packets and observe how the kernel peer responds.
continuation_cursor.why_now: The secured one-lane carrier and native session/control layer are stable. The next roadmap gate is the easy-faketcp-inspired real-return-packet hypothesis: determine experimentally whether a real kernel TCP state machine can keep a public 4-tuple alive and generate coherent return ACK/control traffic while WBD payload remains entirely in the raw unordered path. This must be proven by packet capture rather than assumed from socket state.
continuation_cursor.done_when: M4A has a reproducible Linux capture harness and receipt that records the real kernel SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK handshake, initial client/server sequence numbers, the exact raw-injected payload sequence range, resulting kernel ACK/RST/challenge-ACK behavior and any retransmissions. The kernel anchor socket carries zero WBD/DTLS application bytes. The experiment explicitly concludes PASS only if sequence/ACK behavior is coherent and the raw payload path has no dependency on kernel TCP retransmission/ordered delivery; otherwise it records NO-GO and retains classic udp2raw FakeTCP as the product fallback. This first gate may use synthetic opaque raw payload bytes; DTLS/FEC integration is not required until the packet-state hypothesis itself passes.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: V2-M4A: inspect the local Linux sandbox capabilities for a same-namespace or isolated user+net namespace experiment (raw socket/packet capture, kernel TCP socket and firewall/RST control). Then implement the smallest deterministic capture harness: real kernel TCP listener+client completes handshake on loopback, neither side writes application payload, capture establishes ISN/ACK state, one TCP PSH/ACK packet with synthetic payload is raw-injected in the established sequence space, and capture records the peer kernel response. Do not modify the qualified udp2raw/DTLS/FEC product path yet; if capabilities are insufficient, persist the exact environment blocker instead of substituting an unproven design.
